subject.title: Feature Request: Cross-platform migration tool (migrate export/import)

question: Should OpenClaw core own automated same-product archive import/restore for cross-platform migration, or should core stay limited to safer backup export, platform conversion, verification, and manual restore guidance?
rationale: The choice determines CLI namespace, archive trust boundaries, secret/session portability, destructive-write policy, and how overlapping backup and plugin work should proceed.

options.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
options.body: Define a preview-first core export/import lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, platform remapping, and security tests before implementation.

options.title: Prefer Backup Convert And Manual Restore
options.body: Avoid a destructive importer for now and improve backup output, platform targeting, verification, and public restore docs so users can migrate safely with explicit manual steps.

options.title: Route Optional Work To Plugins
options.body: Keep core focused on missing generic APIs and let ClawHub or plugin packages own cloud, scheduled, encrypted, or workspace-specific migration flows.

recommendation.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
recommendation.body: Define a preview-first core export/import lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, platform remapping, and security tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest observed backup safety history and already raised the restore security-boundary concern in the prior implementation discussion.
